_comment: Secrets bound by deploy/backend.cloudbuild.yaml whose substitution defaults to EMPTY and
which a deploy lane does not pass. add_secret skips empties, so such an omission produces a
service missing that environment variable with no error anywhere.
Substitutions with a non-empty default (e.g. _HUSHH_MANAGED_GEMINI_LIVE_API_KEY_SECRET) are
bound regardless and are deliberately not tracked here.
scripts/ci/check-deploy-secret-coverage.py fails on any omission not listed, and on a listed
entry that no longer matches reality. Adding an entry requires a reason.

reasons._HUSHH_UAT_PHONE_TEST_CHALLENGE_SECRET_S: Pre-existing omission, recorded when this check was added on 2026-09-08. Inherited, not reviewed. Verify against the live service before assuming it is intended.
reasons._HUSHH_PROD_PHONE_TEST_NUMBERS_SECRET: Production-only fixed-OTP test config; must not exist outside production.
